programme.desc: En Gran Bretaña, un virus ha barrido el país, convirtiendo a las personas en zombis. Un escuadrón conjunto de fuerzas especiales británico-estadounidenses ingresa a la zona de cuarentena para extraer un científico que debe tener la posibilidad de curarse.

programme.title: Johnny Z
programme.desc: Un ser mitad humano, mitad zombi llamado Johnny que, bajo la guía de un maestro de artes marciales, busca vengarse de la malvada corporación que lo creó.

programme.title: Quarantine
programme.desc: Una reportera y su cámara se quedan atrapados en un edificio con otra gente cuando, en ese momento, sellan el lugar por una supuesta infección vírica en la ciudad de Los Ángeles. Remake americano de la exitosa película española [REC] de 2007.

programme.title: Un cubo de sangre
programme.desc: Un ayudante de camarero tonto es aclamado como artista por un gato muerto cubierto de yeso que se confunde con una hábil estatuilla. El deseo de más elogios pronto conduce a una serie de obras cada vez más mortales.

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que tan idílico paraje esconde algo extraño. Se da cuenta de que la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: La Senda
programme.desc: En un intento por salvar su matrimonio, Raúl decide pasar las Navidades con su familia en una cabaña aislada en medio de la nieve. Durante la Nochebuena todo parece marchar bien, pero, de repente, la situación da un giro totalmente inesperado.

programme.title: Dictado
programme.desc: Tras quedarse huérfana, Julia es acogida por Daniel y Laura. Daniel percibe en la conducta de la niña un carácter amenazador que le trae a la memoria un pasado terrorífico que había decidido enterrar para siempre.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: La relación de Alex y Evan toma un giro diferente a medida que ambos comienzan de nuevo. Kelly da un salto hacia lo desconocido y Christian propone a Chloe, el nuevo jefe de Miranda, con una canción.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Kelly tiene la mejor noche de su vida, mientras que Alex y Rex tienen una de las más difíciles. Evan se sumerge en el mundo publicitario.

programme.title: The Dead Girl ES
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: Oscuras intenciones
programme.desc: Molly is struggling with being a new mom, but after meeting Beth, things temporarily improve only to turn as Beth's dark intentions are brought to light.

programme.title: A pleno sol
programme.desc: Tom Ripley es un prodigioso impostor, gorrón, falsificador y delincuente de la improvisación en general

programme.title: Crímenes del futuro
programme.desc: Los humanos están mutando y el dolor prácticamente ha desaparecido. En este nuevo mundo, dos artistas performativos han hecho de las operaciones un exitoso y lucrativo arte.

programme.title: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Tres hermanos viajan a un río de Oregón para esparcir las cenizas de su padre muerto. Allí, uno de sus hijos desaparece. El hecho despierta el recuerdo de un secuestro ocurrido en ese mismo lugar 30 años atrás. Para hallarlo, deberá enfrentar su pasado.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Adam es acusado de asesinato por un nuevo mutante con la capacidad de robar los recuerdos de las personas.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Un mutante con habilidades telepáticas que puede hacer que la gente experimente, mentalmente, cualquier cosa que quiera, logra meterse en la mente de Mutante X. Ahora los está haciendo experimentar sus peores miedos.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Cuando Mutante X y Genomex son capturados en una película usando sus poderes, ambos tienen que lidiar con el reportero que planea hacer pública la información.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: El ex novio de Shalimar aparece y está tratando de recuperar un huevo de Fabergé que contiene un microchip de extraordinario poder.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Mala sangre
programme.desc: Dresden se ve envuelto en una lucha territorial entre bandas de vampiros cuando le presionan para volver a saldar una deuda.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Beneficiario esencial
programme.desc: Cuando un hombre muere en la oficina de Harry, este se ve obligado a investigar una compleja trama de asesinato ligada al pasado de Bob.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Muros
programme.desc: Dresden acepta un caso sin cobrar después de presenciar la muerte de una mujer que le pide ayuda, pero su investigación le lleva a la magia negra y más muerte.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Frente tormentoso
programme.desc: Dresden se enfrenta al Consejo Superior cuando sospechan que él es responsable de matar a una universitaria y a un mafioso con magia negra.

programme.title: Mopias
programme.desc: Bel y Judith deciden volver solas al refugio de Ginebra para encontrar pistas de Pere. La mujer les ofrece ayuda, pero necesita objetos de Pere. Esto lleva a Bel a enfrentarse a su pasado y a Nofre, el coordinador del campamento.

programme.title: Mopias
programme.desc: Bel y Judith buscan a Pere con las indicaciones de Ginebra, en un camino largo y lleno de peligros por las entrañas de la sierra de Tramuntana. Un viaje que pone a prueba las capacidades y los miedos de las dos chicas.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Ángel Oscuro, Demonio Brillante
programme.desc: Una corriente de deslizamiento envía a la Andrómeda de vuelta en el tiempo a justo antes de que cayera la Mancomunidad. La tripulación debe intervenir para preservar la historia.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Los Lazos que Atan
programme.desc: Responder a una llamada de socorro lleva a la tripulación a recoger al hermano de Beka, ahora un Wayist, y a su amigo.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Los Bancos del Leteo
programme.desc: Un agujero negro permite a Dylan comunicarse con su ex prometida, 300 años en el pasado.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Una Rosa en las Cenizas
programme.desc: Dylan es encarcelado en un planeta carcelario y debe organizar una fuga mientras su tripulación intenta organizar su propio rescate.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 5

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 6

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Curtis, Kelly, Alisha y Simon aún creen que Nathan está muerto pero un misterioso hombre enmascarado lo guía a la tumba. De vuelta en el centro comunitario, Lucy aparece el día de la liberación de un ala psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Jamie, el hermano de Nathan, aparece en el centro comunitario pero Nathan apenas sabe que tenía un hermano.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 3
programme.desc: El hombre de la máscara aparece de nuevo justo a tiempo de salvar a Alisha de un atracador. Alisha sale para descubrir exactamente quién es este hombre misterioso pero pronto se ve superada.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 4
programme.desc: Ollie, el nuevo chico, aparece para empezar sus trabajos para la sociedad y resultó ser que el también tiene un poder, ¿tomará la banda a un nuevo miembro?

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962. Appearing with a group that includes the French pianist George Arvanitas, one-time Duke Ellington bassist Jimmy Woode, and expat drummer Kansas Fields, the musician also known as ‘Bean' and ‘Hawk' serves up an hour-long set of familiar standards bookended by Hank Jones' “Chant” and J. J. Johnson's “Wee Dot”.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Walter Trout, Johnny Griparic, Teddy Andreadis "Zig Zag" & Michael Leasure
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is the Walter Trout Band. Trout, who was born in New Jersey and is based in Los Angeles, is a world-famous contemporary blues rock guitarist and vocalist.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Charles Bradley, William Aukstik, Frederick Deboe & Michael Deller
programme.sub-title: Charles Bradley: The Screaming Eagle Of Soul
programme.desc: This concert of soul singer Charles Bradley (1948-2017) was recorded in an intimate setting in Paris in September 2014. Before considering a career in music, Bradley had long tried to make ends meet with a series of small jobs. It was only in 1996 that he finally followed in the footsteps of his idol and soul icon James Brown, with whom he shared an exceptional ability to bring audiences to ecstasy. Bradley has developed a unique sound that combines funk, soul, and R&B, but still tinged with Brown influences.

programme.title: The Monty Alexander Trio
programme.sub-title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. On July 13, 1979, talented Jamaican pianist Monty Alexander was joined by Reggie Johnson (bass), Frank Gant (drums), Bobby Thomas (hand drum), and Othello Molineaux (steel drum) at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Alexander's Caribbean influences and natural flair for the piano shine through in this brilliant performance.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba, Ron Carter & Jul Barretto
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1994, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here. With bassist Ron Carter - one of the living legends on this instrument - and highly talented Cuban jazz drummer Julio Barreto, Rubalcaba's trio marks an important step in the development of jazz trio playing in the 1990s. Moreover, it demonstrates the brilliant improvisational and technical abilities of Gonzalo Rubalcaba, who has become one of our present-day jazz legends.

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.

programme.title: Daniel Harding & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.sub-title: Brahms Tragic Overture & Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival's 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms's Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan'. Brahms composed his concert overture during the summer of 1880. With its dark and tumultuous character, it could be regarded as the serious counterpart of his more joyful Academic Festival Overture, Op. 80. Mahler completed his first symphony eight years later, in 1888. Originally a five-movement piece, the composer discarded the second movement ‘Blumine' some years later, resulting in the final four-movement version we know today. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Stephanie Childress, Alina Ibragimova & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress conducts the London Symphony Orchestra and Sibelius and Mendelssohn provide the soundtrack for this unique concert with a distinctly Northern European flavor, live from London's LSO St Luke's. The evening begins with Jean Sibelius's En Saga, a symphonic poem that, like its composer, has become a defining figure of Finnish national musical identity. On the other side of the Baltic, it took Mendelssohn six years to complete his famed Violin Concerto—and it was well worth the wait, as violin virtuoso Alina Ibragimova's powerhouse rendition will demonstrate! The concert ends in style with two short works from Finland: Lumière et pesanteur by the fabulous Kaija Saariaho—ranked the world's greatest living composer by BBC Music Magazine—and another work by the endlessly inventive Sibelius, the spirited and episodic Cassazione.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa & Maurizio Baglini
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni's Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong Liszt's Two Elegies for cello and piano Chopin's Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3 and Rachmaninoff's Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein's iconic composition ‘Tonight' from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

Girl power is alive and kicking and ready to take on the Romans

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: Red Dog: The Early Years
programme.desc: The heart-warming sequel to the box-office triumph Red Dog. A paw-some adventure starring Pan's Levi Miller and Harry Potter favourite Jason Isaacs. A young boy discovers a puppy covered in blue paint, while living on a ranch with his grandma. Together they em-BARK on an exciting adventure and become the best of friends. A touching, uplifting coming-of-age tale for all the family.

programme.title: Battle for Skyark
programme.desc: Witness the greatest battle for peace, justice and mankind in this fantasy thriller. The earth has been taken over by vicious monsters, and humans have taken refuge in the sky in the city, Skyark. When Skyark starts overcrowding the rich and powerful mercilessly dump the poor and the orphans back to the desolate earth. Among them a boy who is determined to make things right.

programme.title: Nine Bullets
programme.desc: Gypsy Moon is a novelist by day and when night falls, she dances to earn her keep .However, when the family next door to her is brutally attacked and murdered by crime boss Jack and his thugs. Gypsy finds herself the protector to a young boy and his dog the only survivors of the attack. Gypsy quickly realises she is the only thing that stands between them and their survival.

programme.title: Blood and Money
programme.desc: Combining edge-of-your-seat thrills, suspense and breath-taking cinematography, acting legend and Academy Award nominee Tom Berenger (Inception) stars as a retired veteran who, whilst hunting in the snowy outback of Northern Maine, discovers a dead body and a bag full of cash. Violence quickly escalates when a group of criminals in search of the loot turn the hunter in to the hunted.

programme.title: The Operative
programme.desc: Munich meets Homeland in this pacy psychological thriller, based on the hit novel The English Teacher by Yiftach R. Atir. Rachel (Diane Kruger, Inglourious Basterds), a rogue spy from Israel's feared national intelligence force vanishes. Following a cryptic phone call, her former handler Thomas (Martin Freeman, The Hobbit Trilogy) must retrace her steps to uncover the threats that lie ahead.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: The Way Back is the critically acclaimed new release from renowned director Peter Weir (Master and Commander, The Truman Show), starring Colin Farrell, Jim Sturgess, Ed Harris, Mark Strong and Saoirse Ronan.

programme.title: Warrior
programme.desc: The youngest son (Hardy) of an alcoholic former boxer (Nolte) returns home, where he's trained by his father for competition in a mixed martial arts tournament -- a path that puts the fighter on a collision corner with his older brother (Edgerton).

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: The Nomads
programme.desc: Amidst the chaos of massive budget cuts and school closures, a newly appointed teacher introduces men's rugby to an inner-city North Philadelphia high school.

programme.title: CHRISTMAS LOVE LETTER
programme.desc: (2019) Intriguing Christmas romance with Ashley Newbrough. A relationship advice columnist receives an unsigned love letter. But as she hunts for the mystery writer, can she also find true love?

programme.title: If Only We Had Christmas
programme.desc: (2020) Festive romance starring Candace Cameron Bure. When a publicist teams up with a cynical VP to help a charity in need, will a surprise revelation put paid to their promising romance?

programme.title: Charming Christmas
programme.desc: (2015) Holiday romance with Julie Benz. An uptight woman agrees to play Mrs Claus at her family's department store, and finds herself becoming merrier working alongside a charming man playing Santa.

programme.title: Christmas on Honeysuckle Lane
programme.desc: After her parents' death, Emma returns home to celebrate Christmas for the last time with her siblings in the house they grew up in. Starring Alicia Witt (2018)

programme.title: A Taste of Love
programme.desc: A struggling TV chef returns home to find that her family's restaurant is for sale, not able to compete with contemporary cuisine. Trying to save it, she reconnects with her childhood sweetheart and finds the inspiration she was seeking.

programme.title: Diana
programme.desc: Celebrated and adored by millions, she was the Queen of people's hearts, yet the bittersweet story of the last man to truly capture hers has never before. In a story that until now has remained untold, Diana introduces a time in the Princess's life that was important in shaping her final years...

programme.title: Love is a Piece of Cake
programme.desc: Jessie Dale is a third generation baker who loves her cake shop more than anything in the world. When developers threaten to buy her building and force her out, she must do all she can to save her bakery, all while juggling a blossoming romance with her client's brother.

programme.title: The Charm of Love
programme.desc: Art historian Madison “Maddie” TURNER, an expert in ancient artifacts and in deflecting unwanted male attention, travels halfway around the world to the Caribbeans in order to find the legendary "Lovers Stone".

programme.title: Christmas For Three
programme.desc: When a successful bachelor suddenly finds himself as the guardian of a 10 year old boy, he leans on the smart and beautiful social worker for help, only to fall in love with the woman who turned his life upside down.

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina moves into her friend's suite at The Chesterton Hotel as she waits for her divorce settlement to come through on Christmas Day. While there, she starts a whirlwind romance with a billionaire, who proposes to her.

programme.title: Love Under The Stars
programme.desc: When a 30-something woman living in an infinite state of youth is finally forced out into the real world, she befriends a young girl and a widower that will teach her that it is okay to grow up.

programme.title: Dancing Through Christmas
programme.desc: OLIVIA is picked to run the Christmas recital of The Nutcracker. When a video of Michael practising ballet with Lily goes viral, Olivia sees how much dance really means to the community. Will Olivia be able to save her dance studio with Michael's help?

programme.title: Moving McAllister
programme.desc: Rick Robinson is a ladder-climbing law intern from Miami with four days until the Bar Exam. Desperate to score points with his boss (McAllister), he commits to a favor he can't afford. He ends up in a rundown truck headed to L.A. with his boss's possessions, his Hollywood-bound niece, and her pet pig. Amidst hitch-hikers, breakdowns, and assorted local yokels, Rick finds love, life and maybe himself in this trans-American road trip from hell.

programme.title: Changing Hearts
programme.desc: James Reed is quite content with the successful life he's built for himself, complete with beautiful girlfriend and great reputation in his big city career. After receiving an urgent call about his father's health, James reluctantly returns home to help with the family B&B business. James must learn about sacrificing for the ones he loves, even at the expense of his own dreams.

programme.title: Love in Focus
programme.desc: When the hit show actress Jenna Wilde stars in suddenly gets cancelled, the press start circling. To escape the chaos Jenna retreats to a snowy cabin in the mountains. Unexpectedly, she must share this peaceful place with a rude and rugged nature photographer Chris Dixon. Their coolness towards each other starts to thaw when Chris helps Jenna audition for other shows.

programme.title: An Uncommon Grace
programme.desc: Following her tour of duty, army nurse Grace Conner (Macallan) returns to her grandmother's (McGillis) farm in Amish country. After arriving she answers Levi Troyer's (Faris) call for medical assistance following a mysterious shooting at the nearby Troyer family farm.

programme.title: Beauty and The Billionaire
programme.desc: Addison gets roped into traveling overseas with her brother and his picky billionaire boss. But clashing with the billionaire is no vacation, until he starts to have a change of heart.

programme.title: Buried in Barstow
programme.desc: Angie Harmon plays Hazel King, a single mom concealing her past.

programme.title: Death Saved My Life
programme.desc: Jade (Meagan Good) appears perfect but her life is far from idyllic behind doors.

programme.title: Escaping My Stalker
programme.desc: Taylor lived on the streets until she was taken in by Larry and Sandy Stewart.

programme.title: Brandi/Joseph/Sam and Suzanne
programme.desc: Brandi and her friend, Liz, offer a ride to man who turns on them.

programme.title: Buried in Barstow
programme.desc: Angie Harmon plays Hazel King, a single mom concealing her past.

programme.title: The Great New Wonderful
programme.desc: The Great New Wonderful weaves five stories against the backdrop of an anxious and uncertain post-9-11 New York City.

programme.title: Killer in Suburbia
programme.desc: Gina and her daughter move to a new town, but when she is abducted, Gina must save her and trust no one.

programme.title: The Joneses Unplugged
programme.desc: With their relationship under strain, a young couple decides to ditch the distractions of technology in order to reconnect to one another.

programme.title: Meet Me in New York
programme.desc: Events planner Kelly meets her match in web editor Joe when planning his niece's birthday party.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a harried workaholic is given a universal remote that allows him to pause, rewind or skip past portions of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best of his life.

programme.title: Major League II
programme.desc: The Indians are now a World Series contender. But last year's hunger is now replaced with complacency, and bad decisions by the new owner threaten to tear the team apart.

programme.title: Dick (1999)
programme.desc: Two clueless teenagers unwittingly get involved in the Watergate scandal that brought down the Nixon administration.

programme.title: Whatever It Takes (2000)
programme.desc: Best friends and neighbors, Ryan Woodman and Maggie Carter, are four weeks away from the prom, and they've agreed to go together if they don't have real dates. Then Chris, a cool guy from the football team, offers to help Ryan connect with Ashley, a popular blond. In exchange, a la Cyrano, Chris needs Ryan's help to get close to Maggie. Ryan makes the deal, helps the dastardly Chris play Maggie, takes advantage of Ashley's lack of self-esteem, loses his values, makes fun of his geeky friends, and falls in Maggie's estimation. Maggie is fooled by Chris, poised to be his next score. Before prom night is over, with its Titanic theme, will Ryan stop sinking?

programme.title: Girl Asleep
programme.desc: The world is closing in on Greta Driscoll. On the cusp of turning fifteen she can't bear to leave her childhood, it contains all the things that give her comfort in this incomprehensible new world.

programme.title: Lars and the real girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars strikes up an unconventional relationship with a doll he finds on the Internet. On the advice of a doctor, his family and neighbours go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Bogus
programme.desc: When a young boy's mother dies, he invents an imaginary friend to accompany him to his new home far away. How can a boy be lonely with a gentle giant named Bogus? Gerard Depardieu and Whoopi Goldberg star together for the first time in this warmhearted tale of magic and fantasy.

programme.title: Gambit
programme.desc: Harry Deane is a man with a plan. Art curator for media tycoon Lord Lionel Shahbandar, Harry devises an elaborate plot to con Shahbandar into purchasing a fake Monet painting.

programme.title: Boot Hill Bandits
programme.desc: Shady town businessman Bolton seems to be the leader of the gang but even he takes his order from a higher authority who may have tried to take Marshal Corrigan's life.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks.

programme.title: Seven Alone
programme.desc: A frontier family crosses the U.S. by wagon train, hoping for a better life in the Oregon Territory.

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: The commander of a Texan fort in the Civil War refuses to surrender to the Northerners, and tries to buy the local Indian tribe chief's daughter. The sage man refuses, and the Southerners massacre the tribe and abduct the young squaw anyway. The noble squaw manages to escape, and hides out with a rough rancher, who dislikes Indians, but hates the Southerners more. The odd couple joins forces, and tactics, to exert ultimate vengeance on the men at the fort.

programme.title: Django... Adios!
programme.desc: Django, a former federal sheriff, is arrested for allegedly stealing a chest full of dollars that was earmarked for the construction of a school and church in Silver City.

programme.title: So Shall It Be
programme.desc: When Sidney and Nigel are about to enter the site of a Bristol lecture, a young author approaches them to follow up immediately on a tip about a map to the lost keys to the druid cult in Stonehenge.

programme.title: Buddhas Bowl
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Nepal to recover Buddha's fabled overflowing alms bowl for villagers who are building a shrine to the original Buddha.

programme.title: The Headless Nun
programme.desc: When Sydney's plane crashes, she's asked by a group of nuns to find the head of another nun who was decapitated several centuries ago.

programme.title: Smoking Gun
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel search for Al Capone's diamond-encrusted gun at the behest of a man hoping it will clear his grandfather of a murder he was framed for.

programme.title: Affaire de Coeur
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to Scotland to find the second ring of the pair of Twining Rings of Calum and Elena.

programme.title: Thank You Very Much
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to Germany to find a lost Elvis Presley guitar.

programme.title: Transformation
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel and Derek Lloyd go to the Peruvian jungle to look for the Paracelsus scrolls which contain the formula for turning lead into gold.

programme.title: Flag Day
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Larivee, California to find the Pioneer's Bear Flag.

programme.title: Saints and Soldiers
programme.desc: Germany, May 1945, deep in the Harz Mountains a U.S. tank crew discovers a platoon of Germans preparing to ambush U.S. supply trucks. A deadly game of cat and mouse quickly unfolds as the Americans find themselves out-gunned and out-manned by three German tanks.

programme.title: The Missing Sister
programme.desc: When Sharon finally tracks down her missing sister Raven, she's elated to be back together – until she begins to suspect that Raven isn't her sister at all, but rather an opportunistic imposter.

programme.title: Birth of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the world of martial arts, there is one man above all: Bruce Lee. San Francisco, 1965.

programme.title: 500 MPH Storm
programme.desc: At 500 MPH disaster is inevitable. When an experiment goes disastrously wrong, a rash of massive hurricanes rips across North America. A scientist must get his family to safety before the hurricanes merge, creating a "hypercane" with the power to wipe America off the map.

programme.title: The Double
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat espionage thriller, starring Richard Gere and Topher Grace as ex-CIA and FBI agents, trying to find the killer of a US senator, which bears the hallmark of an infamous Soviet assassin, thought to be dead.

programme.title: The International
programme.desc: An Interpol agent (Owen) attempts to expose a high-profile financial institution's role in an international arms dealing ring.

programme.title: The Man From Toronto
programme.desc: The world's deadliest assassin and New York's biggest screw-up are mistaken for each other.

programme.title: Krull
programme.desc: A young prince battles aliens and sorcerers to rescue his princess from the Beast on the fantastic planet Krull.

programme.desc: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson (The Rundown, Walking Tall) stars in this gritty and inspirational movie, based on a true story about a group of teenage delinquents given a second chance to redeem themselves by playing football.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Spotlight [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Freeway [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crazed driver with a deeply troubled past goes on a nightly shooting spree across the highways of America.

programme.title: City On Fire [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: An undercover cop infiltrates a gang of thieves who plan to rob a jewelry store.

programme.title: Dog Soldiers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor. The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

programme.title: American Yakuza 2: Back to Back
programme.desc: The violent impulses of Bob Malone (Michael Rooker), a former Los Angeles policeman forced to leave his job in disgrace, get the better of him during a bank robbery, and he wipes out nearly all the robbers. Meanwhile, Koji (Ryo Ishibashi), a Yakuza killer in town to meet with the local Mafia, turns the tables on a deranged terrorist who threatens to bomb an eatery. Corrupt cops bring Koji in, but he soon escapes from custody -- taking Malone and his daughter, Chelsea (Danielle Harris), hostage.

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden : Drame en coulisse
programme.desc: Conviée à une soirée meurtre et mystère, une bibliothécaire voit la fiction se confondre avec la réalité.

programme.title: Comment tuer son mari en 10 leçons
programme.desc: Kate doit retrouver l'assassin de son mari afin de s'innocenter.

programme.title: La boutique des secrets
programme.desc: Suspectée du meurtre de son ancien fiancé, Sandra demande l'aide de Jennifer afin de prouver son innocence.

programme.title: La boutique des secrets
programme.desc: Passionnée de brocantes et d'antiquités, Jennifer effectue une livraison chez un client. Sur place, elle le découvre mort.

programme.title: Don't Knock The Twist
programme.desc: A rock'n' roll musical featuing performances by Chubby Checker, Gene Chandler, Vic Dana, The Carroll and more.

programme.title: Bonjour Tristesse
programme.desc: A playboy and his daughter's hedonistic life on the French Riviers is threatened by the father's mistress.

programme.title: Jeanne Eagels
programme.desc: Actress Jeanne Eagels' troubled career takes her from Broadway stardom to drinking and drug abuse.

programme.title: The Daring Young Man
programme.desc: An army reject inadvertently stumbles into the middle of a Nazi spy ring.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962. Appearing with a group that includes the French pianist George Arvanitas, one-time Duke Ellington bassist Jimmy Woode, and expat drummer Kansas Fields, the musician also known as ‘Bean' and ‘Hawk' serves up an hour-long set of familiar standards bookended by Hank Jones' “Chant” and J. J. Johnson's “Wee Dot”.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Walter Trout, Johnny Griparic, Teddy Andreadis "Zig Zag" & Michael Leasure
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is the Walter Trout Band. Trout, who was born in New Jersey and is based in Los Angeles, is a world-famous contemporary blues rock guitarist and vocalist.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Charles Bradley, William Aukstik, Frederick Deboe & Michael Deller
programme.sub-title: Charles Bradley: The Screaming Eagle Of Soul
programme.desc: This concert of soul singer Charles Bradley (1948-2017) was recorded in an intimate setting in Paris in September 2014. Before considering a career in music, Bradley had long tried to make ends meet with a series of small jobs. It was only in 1996 that he finally followed in the footsteps of his idol and soul icon James Brown, with whom he shared an exceptional ability to bring audiences to ecstasy. Bradley has developed a unique sound that combines funk, soul, and R&B, but still tinged with Brown influences.

programme.title: The Monty Alexander Trio
programme.sub-title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. On July 13, 1979, talented Jamaican pianist Monty Alexander was joined by Reggie Johnson (bass), Frank Gant (drums), Bobby Thomas (hand drum), and Othello Molineaux (steel drum) at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Alexander's Caribbean influences and natural flair for the piano shine through in this brilliant performance.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba, Ron Carter & Jul Barretto
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1994, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here. With bassist Ron Carter - one of the living legends on this instrument - and highly talented Cuban jazz drummer Julio Barreto, Rubalcaba's trio marks an important step in the development of jazz trio playing in the 1990s. Moreover, it demonstrates the brilliant improvisational and technical abilities of Gonzalo Rubalcaba, who has become one of our present-day jazz legends.

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.

programme.title: Daniel Harding & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.sub-title: Brahms Tragic Overture & Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival's 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms's Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan'. Brahms composed his concert overture during the summer of 1880. With its dark and tumultuous character, it could be regarded as the serious counterpart of his more joyful Academic Festival Overture, Op. 80. Mahler completed his first symphony eight years later, in 1888. Originally a five-movement piece, the composer discarded the second movement ‘Blumine' some years later, resulting in the final four-movement version we know today. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Stephanie Childress, Alina Ibragimova & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress conducts the London Symphony Orchestra and Sibelius and Mendelssohn provide the soundtrack for this unique concert with a distinctly Northern European flavor, live from London's LSO St Luke's. The evening begins with Jean Sibelius's En Saga, a symphonic poem that, like its composer, has become a defining figure of Finnish national musical identity. On the other side of the Baltic, it took Mendelssohn six years to complete his famed Violin Concerto—and it was well worth the wait, as violin virtuoso Alina Ibragimova's powerhouse rendition will demonstrate! The concert ends in style with two short works from Finland: Lumière et pesanteur by the fabulous Kaija Saariaho—ranked the world's greatest living composer by BBC Music Magazine—and another work by the endlessly inventive Sibelius, the spirited and episodic Cassazione.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa & Maurizio Baglini
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni's Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong Liszt's Two Elegies for cello and piano Chopin's Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3 and Rachmaninoff's Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein's iconic composition ‘Tonight' from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

programme.title: Ziggy Marley
programme.desc: The Fillmore Auditorium is a historic concert hall in San Francisco, California. Founded by Bill Graham, it was named after being located originally on the corners of Fillmore Street and Geary Boulevard.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood
programme.sub-title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: Problemas en el Paraiso
programme.desc: Rachel, una reciente viuda, viaja de regreso a Estados Unidos en un barco de carga con el cuerpo de su esposo cuando el barco naufraga en una isla desierta. Solo hay otro sobreviviente y ambos están decididos a ser rescatados. Tras una serie de eventos extremos, finalmente son encontrados, pero por su esposo, quien había fingido su muerte.

programme.title: Asesino de tiburones
programme.desc: Los servicios del asesino de tiburones Chase Walker han sido contratados por su hermano Jake, jefe de una banda criminal de la Costa Oeste. El trabajo: matar al tiburón de aleta negra que se tragó un valioso diamante durante una transacción entre bandas. Para vigilar a Chase, se alista a Jasmine, colega de Jake. Pero la relación entre Chase y Jasmine se profundiza con las amenazas de un jefe rival: llevarle el diamante o morir. Pronto, las lealtades cambiarán, y Chase aprenderá que confiar en la sangre es para tontos. Ahora, se enfrentan jefes contra jefes, hermanos contra hermanos y el hombre contra la naturaleza, mientras Chase se esfuerza por rescatar a Jasmine, salvar su propia vida y rastrear al gran tiburón de aleta negra que será el mayor desafío de su carrera.

programme.title: Me case con un desconocido
programme.desc: Emma y David acaban de casarse. Durante su luna de miel, la joven es atacada salvajemente. Su extraño comportamiento y su negativa a cooperar hacen que David se convierta rápidamente en el principal sospechoso. Emma rechaza esta sugerencia, pero empieza a tener dudas: ¿conoce realmente al hombre con el que se ha casado?

programme.title: Piel
programme.desc: Un notorio skinhead se enamora de una mujer y sus tres hijas, y se somete a dolorosos tratamientos para eliminar los tatuajes que cubren todo su rostro y cuerpo, la representación física del odio que mostró al mundo durante más de la mitad de su vida. Basada en la historia real de Bryon Widner.

programme.title: Fanática
programme.desc: Tess, la protagonista femenina de una popular serie de ciencia-ficción, busca apoyo en su asistente cuando cree que su esposo la traiciona sin saber que está cometiendo un grave error.

programme.desc: En 1999, un acosador cibernético acaba matando a los padres de su víctima. 15 años después, la superviviente vive en un nuevo lugar y con otra identidad, porque el asesino aún anda suelto.

programme.title: Todos los animales pequeños
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su madre, Bobby, un joven discapacitado psíquico, queda a merced de su padrastro. Éste, que quiere apoderarse del negocio familiar, le aterroriza y le amenaza con recluirlo en un psiquiátrico. El joven decide huir a través de la campiña inglesa en su viaje, en un accidente de carretera, conoce al señor Summers, quien muestra más interés por un conejo atropellado que por el estado de salud del conductor implicado en el suceso...

programme.title: Las aventuras de Picasso
programme.desc: Ya en su infancia, Pablo Picasso mostró talento por la pintura, y por ello fue enviado a la Academia de Artes de Madrid. Allí s…

programme.title: El sabor del sake
programme.desc: Shubei Hirayama es un viudo que vive con su hija de 24 años, sintiéndose viejo y acabado. Shubei se da cuenta de que ella deber…

programme.title: Diálogo de Carmelitas
programme.desc: En plena Revolución Francesa, la joven Blanche de la Force, decide ingresar en un convento de la Orden Carmelita para protegerse de los conflictos …

programme.title: El dulce porvenir
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar se despeña montaña abajo y se hunde en un lago helado. En el accidente mueren todos los niños del pueblo. El abogado Mitchell Stevens se entrevista con los padres y les propone llevar el caso a los tribunales.

programme.title: El balneario de Battle Creek
programme.desc: El excéntrico doctor John Harvey Kellog es un defensor acérrimo de la vida natural y también regenta un lujoso balneario en Battle Creek, donde reúne a numerosos personajes de clase alta para poner en práctica sus peculiares normas dieteticas.

programme.title: Titanic II
programme.desc: En el 100º aniversario del viaje del Titanic, un moderno crucero de lujo bautizado como Titanic 2, sigue la ruta de su homónimo. Pero cuando un tsunami lanza un iceberg en la trayectoria del nuevo buque, los pasajeros y la tripulación deben luchar para ev

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su padre, dos hijos se enfrentan a las pruebas de sus propias vidas mientras ven a su madre explorar sus propios comienzos.

programme.title: Sí quiero, pero no quiero
programme.desc: Lauren, una joven divorciada que trabaja organizando bodas, se enamora del novio de una de sus clientas.

programme.title: Cortes Peligrosos
programme.desc: Cuatro estilistas de Dublin se convierten en justicieras accidentales y héroes de la comunidad.

programme.title: Un Hombre Solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo venido a menos intenta superar tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera.

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: La noche del viernes es casi como una Nochevieja, llena de sorpresas y con su propia magia especial.

programme.title: ¿Qué les pasó a las abejas?
programme.desc: Millones de abejas murieran en México y las comunidades apicultoras se organizaron para detectar la causa.

programme.title: Socorro, He Encogadio a mi Profe!
programme.desc: Félix, de once años, encoge accidentalmente a la odiosa directora de su colegio al tamaño de un lápiz.

programme.title: Mine
programme.desc: Tras una misión fallida, un soldado (Armie Hammer) se encuentra perdido en el desierto. Expuesto a los elementos, tendrá que sobrevivir a los peligros que le acechan, a la vez que hacer frente a los efectos psicológicos de tan penosa situación.

programme.title: El super canguro
programme.desc: Bob Ho es un superespía secreto de la CIA que decide abandonar su carrera para sentar la cabeza con su novia, Gillian. Pero Bob tiene una última misión que cumplir antes de que Gillian acepte casarse con él: ganarse a sus tres testarudos hijos.

programme.title: En el nombre del rey
programme.desc: Película basada en el popular videojuego Dungeon Siege. Historia de corte medieval en la que un granjero de origen humilde consigue convertirse en un heroico y valeroso príncipe que tendrá que salvar su reino de un oscuro y tenebroso final.

programme.title: Pompeya
programme.desc: Pompeya, año 79 d.C. Milo (Kit Harington, Jon Snow en 'Juego de Tronos'), un esclavo convertido en gladiador, ve cómo a su amor, la joven Cassia, la obligan a prometerse con Corvus, un corrupto senador. Cuando el Vesubio entra en erupción, Milo intentará salvarla... mientras todo se derrumba.

programme.title: Camino hacia la libertad
programme.desc: Un día, un olor familiar distrae al perro de su cometido. Es su dueño Joshua que ha llegado como un prisionero más. El Pastor Alemán no puede traicionar a su amo y le ayudará a huir. Juntos vivirán un duro y largo viaje hacia la libertad y la búsqueda de su hogar.

programme.title: Si no despierto
programme.desc: Fantasía juvenil seria y sincera sobre el destino, que tiene suficiente dimensión trágica para atraer a los jóvenes y a los amantes del entretenimiento con mensaje positivo. Una chica tiene la oportunidad de revivir 7 veces su último día de vida para desvelar el misterio que rodea su muerte.

programme.title: El Desprecio
programme.desc: Katie Lapp ha anhelado las cosas prohibidas, pero ¿sus sueños llegarán a un precio demasiado caro para pagar? ¿Por qué la madre de Katie, una simple mujer amish, escondería un hermoso vestido de bebé en el ático?

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: Una fatídica noche, en un pequeño teatro regional inglés durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, un grupo de actores en gira representan la obra "El rey Lear" de Shakespeare.

programme.title: Eva
programme.desc: Un dramaturgo se refugia en un chalet durante una nevada y conoce a una mujer misteriosa.

programme.title: Una sorpresa real
programme.desc: Cuando el novio de Riley la invita a Sudáfrica para conocer a su familia, ella se sorprende.

programme.title: Para Toda la Vida
programme.desc: Una madre lucha por cuidar a su bebé mientras el padre se aleja de ellos.

programme.title: La Ola Perfecta
programme.desc: ¿Podrías encontrar a tu amor verdadero haciendo surf?

programme.title: Perdido en Florencia
programme.desc: Eric Lombard es un americano con el corazón roto en una fase de su vida en la que tras tomar varias decisiones, decide viajar a Florencia. Allí tratará de descifrar que es lo que más desea, si seguir jugando al fútbol y continuar con su antiguo amor o darle un cambio de rumbo a su vida.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Selena Gomez interpreta a una chica normal cuyo viaje de verano a París resulta ser la fantasía de su vida cuando se convierte en princesa accidentalmente al asumir la identidad de otra persona.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Un joven licenciado de origen humilde se convierte en secretario y persona de confianza de un acaudalado empresario, quien dirige su propia fábrica de acero. A medida que su relación laboral se estrecha, el joven deberá acudir al domicilio del empresario, donde conocerá a su preciosa joven mujer.

programme.title: Seducción a la carta
programme.desc: La magia y la risa son los ingredientes principales de esta historia de amor sobre una propietaria y chef de un restaurante y un jefe de departamento de una tienda que no parecen tener nada en común.

programme.title: Tess
programme.desc: En Inglaterra, a finales del siglo XIX, la humilde familia Durbeyfield descubre que en realidad desciende del ilustre clan de l…

programme.title: Rescate en Nueva York
programme.desc: Cuando la encantadora Kim Chang es secuestrada en un sangriento ataque, el detective Connor Spears es requerido por su hermano Rick para rescatarla de la guerra que mantienen bandas chinas y rusas.

programme.title: El caso Farewell
programme.desc: Moscú, a principios de los 80, en plena Guerra Fría. El coronel del KGB Gregoriev se siente defraudado por el régimen de su país. Se pone en contacto con un joven ingeniero francés, de nombre Pierre Froment. Hombre sin complicaciones hasta entonces, Froment se verá de pronto implicado en uno de los asuntos de espionaje más espectaculares del siglo XX.

programme.title: OSS 117: El Cairo, nido de espías
programme.desc: Egipto, 1955. El Cairo es una verdadero nido de espías. Todos desconfían de todos, todos conspiran contra todos: ingleses, franceses, soviéticos, la familia del rey destituido Farouk que quiere recuperar el trono y la secta religiosa las Águilas de Keops. El presidente de la República francesa, René Coty, envía su arma secreta para poner orden en esta casa de locos al borde del caos: el agente secreto Hubert Bonisseur de la Bath, más conocido como OSS 117.

programme.title: La Primera Navidad
programme.desc: Un ladrón y un sacerdote viajan 2.000 años atrás y deben encontrar las figuras de la Natividad.

programme.title: El Forastero
programme.desc: El forastero procede de un planeta arrasado por el desorden medioambiental y la lluvia radiactiva.

programme.title: Trinidad y Bambino... (Tal Para Cual)
programme.desc: Trinidad descubre que Bambino fue condenado injustamente y huye con él para buscar a los culpables.

programme.title: Sharknado 4: Que La 4 Te Acompañe
programme.desc: Un extraño Sharknado de arena golpea Las Vegas, Fin vuelve a la acción y lucha contra el Sharknado.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Desesperado por una buena historia, un periodista adicto al sexo se sumerge en el mundo de las señoritas de compañía de lujo cuando comienza a seguirle los pasos a una prostituta licenciada en Stanford.

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: Adivina quién
programme.desc: Cuando Theresa trae a su prometido, Simon Green, a casa para el 25.º aniversario de boda de sus padres, se olvida de mencionar un pequeño detalle: es blanco. Decidido a romper el compromiso de su hija, Percy Jones demuestra que el padre no siempre sabe lo que hace.

programme.title: Un padre de cuidado
programme.desc: Tim Allen es Joe, un chico cuya vida ha ido constantemente cambiando para peor. Cuando el acosador de la oficina va demasiado lejos, Joe decide que es hora volverse a sí mismo de un don nadie en un alguien.

programme.title: High School High
programme.desc: Richard Clark es un profesor idealista que trabaja como maestro en una elitista escuela y decide trasladarse al instituto más conflictivo y rebelde de uno de los barrios marginales de la ciudad. Allí, su inocente personalidad y sus sorprendentes técnicas de enseñanza dejarán perplejos a todos los estudiantes y el profesorado. Clark lucha por ser comprendido y no pierde la esperanza de convertir a los alumnos gandules en genios.

programme.title: Exceso De Equipaje
programme.desc: Alicia Silverstone es una chica rica, pero está tan harta de que su padre no se nocupe ella en absoluto que decide fingir su propio secuestro para llamar así su atención. Todo sale según sus planes hasta que un ladrón (Benicio del Toro) roba el coche en cuyo maletero está escondida.

programme.title: Ese Poli Es Un Panoli
programme.desc: Las cosas no salen como se planearon cuando un detective implacable planea una vigilancia en la casa de los Robbersons, junto a la cual está la de un matón de la mafia.

programme.title: Paternidad
programme.desc: Kevin Hart protagoniza esta conmovedora historia real sobre un padre viudo que se enfrenta a dudas, miedos, angustias y pañales sucios mientras se dispone a criar a su hija por su cuenta.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 43, 44, 45
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: El día de los forajidos
programme.desc: Blaise Starrett es un ranchero que se enfrenta a los granjeros cuando los forajidos asaltan el pequeño pueblo. Los forajidos sólo son controlados por su notorio líder, pero se le diagnostica una herida mortal y el pueblo es un polvorín a punto de estallar.

programme.title: El regreso de los cuatro magníficos
programme.desc: El guardabosques retirado de Texas, Nash Crawford, vuelve a montar su antiguo equipo de guardabosques de los viejos tiempos para luchar contra el crimen en su ciudad natal.

programme.title: El jardín del diablo
programme.desc: Tres americanos navegan alrededor del cabo hasta los yacimientos de oro de California cuando son puestos en tierra durante varias semanas en un pequeño pueblo mexicano dormido.

programme.title: 90 días para el 2 de julio
programme.desc: Luis, de 20 años, debe permanecer escondido en una casa durante las elecciones presidenciales, cumpliendo la petición de su novio Andrés, candidato de un partido muy conservador. Una historia de secretos, amor y tensiones políticas.

programme.title: Yo te quiero más
programme.desc: Neycy, joven cubana con sueños rotos, emigra hacia México en busca de libertad, pero cae en las redes de Mario, quien la explota bajo falsas promesas. Entre miseria y dignidad, lucha por cumplir sus sueños. Nueva producción de Andariego Films con Producciones Parabolum.

programme.title: Juegos de la vida
programme.desc: Javier, un adolescente de 17 años, vive mimado y acostumbrado a que sus padres le den todo sin merecerlo. Caprichoso y egoísta, pronto enfrentará las lecciones y juegos de la vida que pondrán a prueba su carácter y lo obligarán a madurar.

programme.title: El pirata
programme.desc: El pirata griego reconvertido en hombre de negocios Ioannis Varvakis hizo fortuna vendiendo caviar en Rusia y en todo el mundo. Varvakis lucha toda su vida por la libertad para sí mismo y luego para su país.

programme.title: Jack Hunter y el tesoro perdido de Ugarit
programme.desc: Jack Hunter, arqueólogo, debe robar una tablilla de un museo en Francia y viaja a Damasco tras el asesinato de su amigo. Junto a Nadia y Tariq, enfrenta peligros de Albert Littman y descubre secretos mientras sigue la pista de la reliquia codificada de Ugarit.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: Martin es un ex parisino que ha regresado a su pueblo natal en Normandía para hacerse cargo de la panadería de su padre. De su juventud le queda una gran imaginación y su pasión por la literatura, con un profundo aprecio por Gustave Flaubert. La emoción le invade cuando un matrimonio inglés se instala en la casa vecina, no sólo porque sus nombres son Gemma y Charles Bovery, sino porque sus comportamientos parecen replicar los de los personajes de la obra Madame Bovary, que incluye una serie de relaciones románticas y sexuales que se encaminan hacia un final incierto. Pero la hermosa Gemma no ha leído la novela clásica, y tiene la intención de vivir su propia vida, en especial cuando su antiguo novio, Patrick, aparezca de nuevo en su vida.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se ve atrapada en un triángulo amoroso inusual. Se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir, pero 30 años después se encuentra perdida en su propia prisión...

programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se ve atrapada en un triángulo amoroso inusual. Se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir, pero 30 años después se encuentra perdida en su propia prisión...

La misión es un éxito, pero Jake, se queda en el campo de batalla para salvar a un soldado herido.

programme.title: Invasión A La Tierra
programme.desc: Durante muchos años ha habido casos documentados sobre testigos que han visto OVNIS en todo el mundo.Pero lo que hasta ese momento eran simples avistamientos, en 2011 se convierte en una terrible realidad cuando la Tierra es atacada por fuerzas desconocidas.Una tras otra van cayendo las grandes ciudades del mundo, y Los Ángeles se ha convertido en el último bastión de la humanidad. Un sargento de la Marina (Aaron Eckhart) y sus hombres tendrán que enfrentarse en una inesperada batalla a un enemigo absolutamente desconocido.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Un grupo de documentalistas se traslada a la selva amazónica para localizar a la tribu indígena de los Shirishama. Este grupo está formado por una directora de cine, Terri Flores (Jennifer Lopez), un antropólogo, Steve Cale (Eric Stoltz), un encargado de sonido, Gary Dixon (Owen Wilson), un cámara, Danny Rich (Ice Cube), un narrador, Warren Westridge (Jonathan Hyde) y una productora, Denise Kahlberg (Kari Wuhrer). A ellos se les une Paul Sarone (Jon Voight), un misterioso ex-sacerdote convertido en cazador, que asegura saber dónde se encuentran los Shirishama, por lo que se convierte en su guía. Pero, en realidad, a donde les dirige es a la caza de un reptil único en el mundo: una inmensa serpiente anaconda de doce metros de largo.

programme.title: After Earth
